responses.en: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurological and developmental condition that begins in the developmental period and affects how a person communicates, interacts, learns, and behaves.
responses.tl: Ang Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) ay isang neurodevelopmental condition na maaaring makaapekto sa komunikasyon, pakikisalamuha, at pag-uugali.

keywords: does this mean my child has autism

responses.en: A screening result does not diagnose ASD. A qualified healthcare professional can conduct a comprehensive evaluation.
responses.tl: Hindi diagnosis ang resulta ng screening. Maaaring magsagawa ng masusing pagsusuri ang isang kwalipikadong healthcare professional.
